about.paragraph: I'm a passionate developer with extensive experience building robust and scalable solutions across the full stack. My expertise lies in leveraging modern technologies like TypeScript, React, and Next.js to create seamless user experiences. I'm also deeply involved in cloud architecture with AWS, IoT integrations, and applying AI to solve real-world problems. From designing intuitive UIs to deploying containerized applications with Docker, I thrive on tackling complex challenges and turning ideas into reality.

experience.description: Led the development of a full-stack IoT platform using Next.js, React, and Node.js. The system utilized sensors to monitor waste levels in real-time, optimizing collection routes and improving efficiency. I was responsible for both the frontend dashboard and the backend data processing pipeline.

Designed and developed custom desktop applications and user interfaces for various clients. My work focused on creating intuitive and visually appealing software, enhancing user engagement and productivity.

Contributed to a client project for Stake Casino, focusing on outreach and integration tasks. This involved working with APIs and ensuring seamless communication between different parts of their marketing platform.

Designed and managed scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS for multiple projects. My responsibilities included setting up CI/CD pipelines, containerizing applications with Docker, and ensuring high availability and performance.
